ea6b730324598f27674e82ed2b4c28e3e0b5a5a6.summary: Bitdefender reports a RIG Exploit Kit campaign that used exploits for CVE-2021-26411 in Internet Explorer to deliver RedLine Stealer, a low-cost password stealer sold on underground forums. Once run, the stealer gathers system details and exfiltrates passwords, saved cards, crypto wallets and VPN logins to a command and control server. Suggested mitigations are exploit detection in anti-virus and EDR, checking indicators of compromise, and keeping systems and third-party applications patched.

eaec34789efaff36c406a8ae812679016743e56a.summary: Cisco Talos reports an ongoing campaign since at least December 2025 by a actor it tracks as UAT-10027, delivering a previously undisclosed backdoor named Dohdoor. Targets were in education and health care, mainly in the United States. Initial access is likely phishing. A batch script and DLL sideloading lead to Dohdoor, which resolves C2 over DNS-over-HTTPS via Cloudflare, uses process hollowing, and unhooks calls monitored by EDR. Talos saw evidence pointing to a likely Cobalt Strike payload, though no payload was recovered. Talos assesses with low confidence a North Korea nexus, citing…
